status: frozen before retrieving any SkyMapper row or opening any WALLABY kinematic target
purpose: Retrieve a uniform, source-only optical candidate universe around every V19BW WALLABY H I centroid without selecting an optical counterpart, evidence split, galaxy, formula, or gravity constant.

primary_source.coverage_reason: DR4 six-band coverage reaches from the South Celestial Pole to declination +16 degrees and therefore contains all three WALLABY PDR1 fields.
primary_source.known_limitation: SkyMapper states that extended-source photometry is not optimized in DR4; the rows are candidates and coverage diagnostics, not definitive galaxy decompositions or stellar masses.

query_policy.ordering: object_id ascending at the service; source name, angular separation and object_id in the combined output

diagnostic_only_flags.usable_r_photometry: r_ngood > 0, r_flags < 4, r_nimaflags < 5, and finite r_petro/e_r_petro
diagnostic_only_flags.extended_candidate: usable r photometry, finite radius_petro, and class_star <= 0.5
diagnostic_only_flags.boundary: These flags summarize candidate density and catalog quality. They do not identify the H I counterpart.

claim_boundary: A SkyMapper object inside 60 arcsec is an optical candidate, not a claimed H I counterpart.
Catalog stellarity, Petrosian radius and quality flags diagnose available source information but do not constitute a bulge fraction, stellar mass or morphology truth label.
No nearest-neighbor choice is used to select a galaxy or tune a force law.
No WALLABY velocity, fitted inclination, kinematic angle, gravity residual, halo result, action, constant, evidence split or Solar-System result enters V19BX.
